messages:
maya: :rotating_light: APAC-edge-2 bringup failing during bootstrap — CI shows instance attach errors and kubelet never Ready. Details in terraform apply log attached.

rick: what error are you seeing? can you paste the ec2/eni error lines?

maya: main thing is a mismatch between the subnet pool assigned in the TF module and the AZ-specific ENI quota. snippet:
```
Error: Could not attach network interface
  status code: 400, request id: abc123
  Message: 'InvalidParameterValue: ENI count per subnet (50) would be exceeded'
```

anita: ah — looks like the apac-edge subnets were created with /22 instead of expected /20 (we used a shared runbook that references eu subnets). that reduces available IPs. (reacts: :facepalm:)

luan: also seeing node labels not applied because cloud-init failed midway. kubelet logs show TLS handshake timeout with our internal CA during initial cert rotation.

jem: deploy-bot: deployment/apac-edge-gpu-pool reported: "rollback triggered: failed 3/3 nodeboots"

deploy-bot: @channel deployment/apac-edge-gpu-pool: rollback initiated due to repeated bootstrap failures. See: https://redwood-internal/ops/deploy/1912345678

maya: quick triage plan: 1) pause autoscaler 2) confirm subnet CIDR vs runbook 3) check ENI quotas per AZ 4) re-run bootstrap with debug cloud-init logs

rick: pausing autoscaler now (cmd: ./scripts/cluster-autoscaler pause apac-edge-2) :white_check_mark:

anita: confirming CIDR — terraform state shows vpc.apac-edge.cidr = 10.20.0.0/22

luan: AWS console shows ENI quota is default 400 per region but per-subnet effective limit is hitting because /22 only gives ~102 addresses and we pre-allocate some for control-plane.

jem: what about spot capacity? last run used mixed instance pools, but if ENIs blocked, nodes fail before joining. also cost note: moving to /20 would increase IP space but could push us above committed spot pool sizes in apac.

maya: suggestion: follow handoff runbook step to create new subnet /20, attach route tables, and update TF variables to point to new subnet, then run a targeted apply for apac-edge subnets only. runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/edge-provisioning

rick: can we avoid full tf apply? we should try a patch: create a new subnet manually and pass its id via a temporary override to ignore other resources.

anita: manual subnet created (subnet-0a1b2c3d) /20 in same AZ. created route table and NAT per runbook. docs: I ran:
```
aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id vpc-0aaa --cidr-block 10.20.0.0/20 --availability-zone apac-southeast-1a
```

luan: re-run bootstrap on a single test node with overridden subnet. cloud-init output:
```
[  OK  ] Started kubelet.
Mar 12 14:33:02 kubelet[1234]: node registered: apac-edge-test-1
```

jem: good, test node joined. but we still saw certificate rotation errors earlier — looks like proxy env was not in cloud-init because user-data template used wrong variable name (HTTP_PROXY vs http_proxy). small but critical mismatch.

maya: noted — update user-data template in infra-templates repo and run a targeted apply. i'll also update the handoff doc to call out proxy env var casing for edge sites.

ops-sre: after manual subnet and template fix, we should run validation checklist: 1) node join smoke 2) scheduling of gpu daemonset 3) sample inference job to validate KV cache priming 4) cost projection update for /20 allocation. I'll take 1-3.

anita: after smoke, autoscaler resume? we should keep scale disabled until we confirm no more ENI saturation.

rick: agreed. resuming autoscaler only after green smoke and capacity check. for audit, i'll push a deploy note summarizing the rollback reasons: ENI per-subnet exhaustion (wrong CIDR), user-data proxy var casing, and early kubelet cert rotation failure.

maya: thanks everyone. action items:
- anita: keep subnet manual until TF patch merged (ETA 2h)
- luan: user-data template PR (ETA 1h)
- rick: deploy note + pause autoscaler maintained (ETA 30m)
- jem: run validation checklist and post results (ETA 3h)

maya: tagging this for handoff when green. will follow up with updated runbook snippets. :thumbsup:
